scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I was wondering if you could tell me the status of my application? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been originated. You were approved for a conventional subordinate lien loan.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you also let me know what my interest rate and the total costs of this loan are? Additionally, is there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 7.53%. The total costs of the loan are $0.00. The loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Could you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? Additionally, what is my debt-to-income ratio and how does it affect my application?
dialogue.agent: The loan has not been sold to another institution. Your debt-to-income ratio is between 30% and 36%. This ratio represents the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts.

dialogue.user: I understand. Thank you for providing that information. It sounds like everything is in order. <Satisfied> The agent was clear and helpful in answering my questions about the loan status, type, interest rate, total costs, and other relevant details. I appreciate the assistance.
